text: The initiative features an independent academic partner, UP BRS, ensuring technical independence and alignment with public-sector governance. It integrates with the development of a new green and ICT-enabled facility, Sandiganbayan Building II, under Supreme Court oversight and government procurement compliance. The project addresses the needs of approximately 600 personnel and a high volume of public transactions, ensuring infrastructure decisions are grounded in operational realities.

metadata.solution_name: Structural Integrity Assessment and Retrofit Design of the Sandiganbayan Centennial Building
